stories.head: Take-Two hits 3,007 GitHub repos of unofficial GTA 6 PC ports with a DMCA takedown
stories.say: Three gaming stories you missed. Number one: VideoCardz reports Take-Two issued a DMCA takedown on 3,007 GitHub repositories for unofficial GTA 6 PC ports. There's still no official PC version.

art.label: GitHub repos hit by Take-Two's DMCA takedown

stories.head: Rockstar cut tennis, crafting and Sims-style home decorating from GTA 6
stories.say: Number two: Rockstar cut tennis, crafting, Sims-style home decorating and movie theater visits from GTA 6, leads Rob Nelson and Scott Mitchell revealed.

stories.head: Ubisoft argued calling Skull and Bones a AAAA game was "classic puffery"
stories.say: And number three: Ubisoft argued that calling Skull and Bones a quadruple-A game was just classic puffery. A judge sided with Ubisoft in August.

art.label: "classic puffery", Ubisoft argued in a lawsuit

outro.head: Want tennis back in GTA 6?
outro.say: Want tennis back in GTA 6? Follow Level Up!
